checks.check: app.py (instrumented original) is started by the entrypoint, still running ~3s later, and writing data entries
checks.requirement: The application is a Python-based data processing service in /app that writes to files periodically; do not change app.py
checks.note: rejects reimplementations such as E and entrypoints that stop by themselves

checks.check: after SIGTERM to PID 1, app.py's own SIGTERM handler runs (secret probe file contains token:SIGTERM)
checks.requirement: The Python app receives SIGTERM and performs its cleanup (writes shutdown marker)
checks.note: PID 1 emulated with bwrap --as-pid-1, with a non-namespaced fallback; rejects shell-faked cleanup (A, C)

checks.check: PID 1 exits less than 10 s after SIGTERM
checks.requirement: The container exits within a few seconds, not hitting the default 10-second timeout

checks.check: /app/data/shutdown_complete absent before SIGTERM, present after with content shutdown_complete:SIGTERM
checks.requirement: The file /app/data/shutdown_complete is created to indicate clean shutdown
checks.note: content follows from app.py's f-string with signal name SIGTERM

checks.check: output.txt contains '--- END OF DATA (clean shutdown) ---'
checks.requirement: Data files are sometimes corrupted/incomplete because the app doesn't shutdown cleanly
